Application Data.NAME: Global Adventure Travel, Inc.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Global Adventure Travel, Inc. specializes in offering personalized travel solutions, including tailor-made vacation packages, group tours, and travel consulting services. Our operations encompass a diverse range of travel arrangements, from leisure and adventure travel to corporate travel planning, ensuring each client receives exceptional service tailored to their unique needs. We also provide support for travel insurance, visa applications, and local experience recommendations, making us a one-stop shop for all travel-related inquiries and reservations.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 06/15/2022, a client trip to Europe was canceled due to a sudden travel advisory. The agency incurred costs totaling $2,500 for non-refundable airline tickets and hotel reservations. The claim has been filed with the previous carrier and is currently under review, with resolution expected by the end of the month.
